R1.description: /prune-archives <archive-name>...: user-only; previews prune <names> (a dry run), prints the sentence "Prune the archives <n1>, <n2>." and stops; only a current-turn sentence whose set of names equals the named set (full stop required, prefix-safe, subsets and supersets rejected) runs prune <names> --apply; any engine refusal is reported with its code and next step, never retried; never an archive not named; the command deletes nothing itself

R2.description: Tests and documents: T1 to T8 with failure-only mutations; COMMAND_FILES.md nine, operator reference section and counts 25, section 6.1 of ORCHESTRATION_PROTOCOL.md lists /archive-finished-item and /prune-archives (#123 item 1), docs/RETENTION.md section and the two prune-table edits (#126 items 2 and 3); the four release classes move to 83/57; no engine, state or protocol change
